messages:
Liz H: Kicking off a mini-wave deploy for model-serving v2.2 — targeting a gradual 'wave' ramp. Tentative timeline: 2026-03-14T21:00:00Z start.
Devon K: I can own the smoke checks. What's the ramp plan?
Liz H: 0.5% -> 1% -> 5% over 30m steps. NA only first wave, then EU if green. Each step hold 30m unless rollback/abort.
Maria S: Cohort selection: new users + 1% of low-risk pay customers. Exclude SSO/enterprise accounts. Any objections?
Shawn P: No objections. Confirming metrics: p50 latency, error rate, 5xxs, model-quality regressions.
Devon K: I'll watch p50/p95, token cost delta, and end-to-end errors. Set alert thresholds?
Liz H: Alert triggers: +20% p50 vs baseline OR +2% absolute error rate OR spike >300 5xxs/5m. Manual rollback if any unseen failure.
ops-bot: smoke-checklist created: /infra/smokes/model-serving-v2.2 — includes load test, SLO dashboard, logs, fallback validation.
Devon K: Will run smoke checklist 10m before first ramp and after each step.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout job created: rollout_id=rw-roll-1768321110, stages=[0.5,1,5], hold_minutes=30, regions=[na]
Maria S: Quick note: disable cached-prefix on canary to surface regressions.
Shawn P: Do we have a canary feature flag to isolate traffic? Need flag name to verify in logs.
Liz H: Flag: rollout.wave_v2_2. Logs show flag in request header X-RW-WAVE.
Devon K: Example curl to hit canary control plane:
```
curl -H "X-RW-WAVE: rollout.wave_v2_2" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"serve-v2","prompt":"smoke test"}'
```
Maria S: I'll run a small eval suite on canary responses (20 prompts) and report quality drift.
Shawn P: If any step breaches alerts, immediate rollback to previous model variant and notify #incidents.
Liz H: Post-mortem owner if needed: Devon. If green after full NA wave and 1h stable, expand EU with same steps.
Devon K: Acknowledge. I'll ping when the first smoke is done. :thumbsup:
Liz H: Thanks team — tagging @oncall infra for visibility. Launching in ~40m.
ops-bot: deploy job rw-roll-1768321110 started by Liz H — step 0.5% in NA. Live link: https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/rw-roll-1768321110
Devon K: Smoke run started.
Devon K: Smoke OK — no errors, p50 within baseline.
deploy-bot: stage 1 -> increase to 1% completed.
Maria S: Eval run in progress (20/20)
Maria S: Eval OK — no quality regressions detected.
Shawn P: Monitoring stable. No 5xxs.
deploy-bot: stage 2 -> increase to 5% completed.
Devon K: Final smoke OK. Proceed to full NA roll in 1h.
Liz H: Great. I'll file a short rollout note after NA completes. Thanks all.
